source: STEER Project (Save the Children, iDE Cambodia, and the Cambodian Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries) - "Guide on Banana Cultivation Techniques" (សៀវភៅណែនាំស្តីអំពី បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះដំណាំចេក), February 2020
text:
Chek Ambong Maok (ចេកអំបូងមាស) and Chek Ambong Chiev Leung (ចេកអំបូងឆួវលើង) are two closely related banana types grown in Cambodia alongside the main Ambong, Pong Moan and Namva varieties. Like other local varieties, they are propagated from corm pieces or suckers rather than from seed.

This source does not document a distinguishing pest or disease profile specific to these two types beyond the general banana pest and disease list that applies to all varieties grown in Cambodia (see the pest and disease management entries in this batch).
